scientific.integrity: All eight source equations, positive equilibria, next-generation threshold, discriminant, and full eight-dimensional characteristic polynomials were reconstructed. Exact rational Routh arrays and compartment-stationarity certificates were replayed from the bundled standalone checker. The motivating source, its same-equation fractional follow-up, and a broad reinfection-threshold paper were inspected in full text; a distinct SEIRE preprint was accessible only in abstract. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: Exact rational intervention family, equilibria for all nonnegative recovered vaccination rates, local spectral classification at zero recovered vaccination only; global eradication, normal forms, calibration, and universal parameter results are not claimed.

title: A sharp recovered-vaccination threshold for subcritical endemic bistability
